title: Ley Gaeyan Nay Ridawaan
body:
Leh gaeyan nay ridawaan maan bhaini da Ghazi aa wi ji..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Zahra jaeyaan teray raah waikhan sun dukhiyan di lay sada .
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Teray hisay diyan baqi jo sazawaan bachiyan
Kalma go aa waikh lay Ghazi raye dainday sanu bhira.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Koi mehmal koi burqa jay howain lay aawaan
Uth tarteeb saday safraan di, uth kay veer tu bana.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Alma walay di bahwaan da lahu loka nay
Doleya ujriyan day rowan lae, samnay kahimeya da Ja .
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Baad Ghazi day zulam di inteha mildi rahi
Rul gaye sham day bazaraan wich jehray yasrab walay nay shah ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Qaid ta ho gae Samar per jandi nae Zainab
Keewain turna si nal ghairaan day bina Ghazi day bay rida.
